context: The binary search trees in this book do not store duplicates. At every node, all values in its left subtree are smaller than its value, and all values in its right subtree are larger.

The input tree has root 8 with left child 4 and right child 12. Node 4 has left child 2 and right child 6, and 12 has left child 10 and right child 14. Nodes 2, 6, 10, and 14 are leaves. A dashed green path traces the traversal, and blue dots show when each node is recorded.
prose.result: Inorder traversal yields ascending values without a separate sort. The sequence is strictly increasing because this book's definition excludes duplicate node values.
